title: Fold a sheet of paper 42 times

probes.question: Assume 0.1 mm paper. How thick, in km, would the stack be after 42 folds in half?

image.alt: A stack of flat teal and navy layers that grows thicker toward the top, with a dotted arc rising from it to a pale Moon in the upper right.

body.question: Assume a sheet of paper is 0.1 mm thick. If you could fold it in half 42 times, about how thick would the stack be, in kilometres?
body.reveal: About 440,000 km, which is farther than the Moon (roughly 380,000 km away). Each fold doubles the thickness, so 0.1 mm × 2^42 ≈ 440 million metres.
